verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs say it will 'calculate and file taxes automatically' and handle 'all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments.' A community report confirms Gusto produces employees' W-2 forms, including issuing W-2c corrections, though in that case they were erroneous. Nothing explicitly documents year-end W-2/1099 generation or delivery to workers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic W-2 generation, 1099-NEC generation for contractors, distribution of forms to workers (portal/mail/e-delivery), and independent corroboration that year-end forms are produced reliably.
